thread:
lina: Partner ask from CloudMart: they send per-minute usage across multiple SKU tiers and expect us to fold into our hourly marketplace entitlements. They include optional per-device lists and per-sku weights. They want a clear audit trail for marketplace reconciliation.

thor: Key questions: how do we attribute minutes to SKUs when partner sends tiered totals? What if device lists are missing? How to record provenance for audit and chargeback?

sam: propose canonical event for ingestion: gateway_id | minute_utc | sku_id | units | source_batch | provenance_tag. Idempotency key = source_batch + gateway_id + minute. We'll persist raw minute rows and derived hourly attributions with provenance columns.

lina: sample CloudMart payload they shared (condensed):
```
{
  "gateway": "cm-gw-2",
  "batch": "cm-20250801-77",
  "tz": "America/Chicago",
  "minute_summaries": [
    {"t": "2025-08-01T09:12:00-05:00", "skus": [{"sku":"S1","units":12},{"sku":"S2","units":3}], "devices": ["d1","d2"]},
    {"t": "2025-08-01T09:13:00-05:00", "skus": [{"sku":"S1","units":8}], "devices": null}
  ]
}
```

thor: If devices are null we should attempt fallback attribution: 1) use last-known device roster within 24h; 2) if none, apply SKU-weighted split across last-24h device distribution; 3) if still unknown, mark minute as AGGREGATE_ONLY for audit and apply conservative billing (credit partner or bill baseline depending on contract).

audit-bot: Created audit-record template CM-ATTR-001 for provenance (fields: source_batch, minute_utc, attribution_method, confidence_score, derived_units).

sam: billing tiers decision draft:
- >=48 minutes with explicit device lists and SKU mapping in hour => full attribution; bill per-device per-sku sums.
- 24-47 minutes => partial attribution; reconstruct missing minutes using per-device historical ratios over last 7d, cap per-device adjustment to 20% and cap total adjustment to 10%. Mark confidence_score accordingly.
- <24 minutes => aggregate-only; bill using conservative baseline (partner-specific baseline if in contract), and auto-open reconciliation ticket.

lina: partners sometimes send per-sku weights instead of device lists. We'll accept weights and use them to split totals; weights must sum to 1 (or we normalize). Acceptable to request partner-provided weights in initial onboarding.

sam: storage/retention: raw minute-level for 14 days (audit need), attributed minute and hourly rollups for 90 days, full provenance CSV export for partner queries for 30 days in S3. Finance wants an estimate of S3 costs; we'll send numbers after spike test.

audit-bot: Added alert rule: attribution confidence < 0.6 for any marketplace partner will create PART-7800 auto-ticket and include daily digest to partnerships/finance.

thor: testing & replay: e2e harness should include: 1) mixed payloads (some minutes with sku list+devices, some with sku only, some aggregate totals), 2) device roster churn mid-hour, 3) late-arriving minutes up to 3h, 4) DST cutover in partner tz. Provide replay API to recompute hour-level charges from raw minutes for audits.

lina: action items:
- sam: PR for ingest schema + idempotency + retention policy (due Mon)
- thor: PoC for weighted reconstruction + confidence scoring and unit tests (due Thu)
- lina: partner onboarding checklist update and partner acceptance template (due Tue)
- finance: request: quick cost estimate for 14d raw retention and 30d CSV export (ask finance-team)

billing-bot: Created ticket PART-7800: "CloudMart SKU-tier attribution + audit CSV" assigned to lina, sam, thor. ETA 2025-08-08

lina: partner-approved compromise: CloudMart will provide device rosters for 95% of minutes for the first 30 days of pilot; we'll run the weighted attribution fallback for the rest and surface CSVs for audit.

sam: note: always convert incoming timestamps to UTC before bucketing. Document behavior for leap seconds as "no special handling; recorded as received".

thor: will add confidence_score computation: combine percent-explicit-minutes (0-1 scaled) and variance-from-historical (0-1 scaled) into a [0,1] score. We'll include this in attributed rows.

lina: scheduling a 40m pilot kickoff with CloudMart and eng on Mon 15:00 UTC. tagging @sam @thor :calendar:

lina: closing thread; will post partner roster and sample CSV layout after kickoff. :white_check_mark:
